That covers a different pair, and it never states that a default build defines neither of the two. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is not enabled in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h`. ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are both commented out (lines 2185, 2196). | WHY: The item requires the two threading macros left undefined; the answer says THREADING_C is not enabled and PTHREAD/ALT are commented out, so it names three macros and not the required pair, though it implies none is defined. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is not enabled in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h`. ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are both commented out (lines 2185, 2196). | WHY: The item requires the two threading macros to be THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD/ALT as a pair left undefined.
